title: Crossing App — home screen + menu mockup

how.text:
Press Play on the phone, then tap around.

Plan (home) = the answer first, then scroll for the reasons: departure times, best day, hour by hour, map + radar, tides, inside water, fuel, get ready. Tap a departure time or ⇄ Trip home to see it change.

Side tools live in ☰ Menu.

All numbers are sample data.

coverage.text:
Feature map check (Nov 17)

In the mockup: everything Live now, Friends version and Paid beta, all 11 Add-now competitor features, and the My Boat tools for Phases 1–2.

Shown as Soon/Later only: logbook, anchor alarm, document storage, SOS.

Not shown yet (Later on the board): find my friends, multiple boats on one map, no-signal location, plus the Soon/Later competitor ideas (stopped alert, two-way messages, marinas, comfort score, recap card).

onb.text:
Onboarding (first open), about 2 minutes:

Welcome ("Know when to go." + family can watch you cross live) → 1 Safety tick box (captain decides; agree to Terms and Privacy) → 2 Guided chat: 7 quick questions, talk, type or tap → 3 Build your boat (hull type, stripe color, or use a photo; line drawing later) + check the numbers → 4 Limits → 5 Route → 6 Who follows you → 7 Location, notifications, keep screen on → First GO answer.

"A friend sent me their setup" skips the chat and pre-fills everything.

Try: tap Talk or the answer chips on step 2, pick "Not sure" for fuel burn, then switch hull types on step 3.
